snippet.description:
Current affairs is not just about knowing what happened. It is about knowing what UPSC can ask you about it.

Join the Current Affairs Pre-cum-Mains Orientation & 1st Class with Santosh Sir to understand how current affairs can be prepared for both Prelims and Mains without getting lost in endless information.

Download the handouts here: https://t.me/Santoshkumarcurrentaffairs/12679

In this session, Santosh Sir will cover:

Federalism and Associated Issues
Fiscal Federalism
Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2026
Finance Commission and Its Significance
16th Finance Commission: Recommendations and Analysis

The program brings together relevant issues, authentic sources, exam-focused analysis and answer-oriented preparation.

Enroll Now in Current Affairs Pre-Cum-Mains 2027: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-current-affairs-pre-cum-mains/
